evidence: Lighthouse identified buttons that do not have an accessible name.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not be able to determine the purpose of these buttons.
recommended_fix: Provide a clear accessible name using meaningful visible text or an appropriate accessible label.

evidence: Lighthouse identified image elements without alt attributes.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may miss important information conveyed by informative images.
recommended_fix: Add meaningful alternative text to informative images and appropriate empty alt attributes to decorative images.

evidence: Lighthouse identified links that do not have a discernible accessible name.
user_impact: Users of assistive technologies may have difficulty understanding the destination or purpose of links.
recommended_fix: Give meaningful links an accessible name that clearly describes their destination or action.

evidence: Lighthouse reported insufficient contrast between background and foreground colors.
user_impact: Users may have difficulty reading text, particularly users with low vision or reduced contrast sensitivity.
recommended_fix: Adjust the foreground and background colors to provide sufficient contrast and improve readability.

evidence: Lighthouse identified an incorrect heading order and showed a failing h5 element.
user_impact: Assistive-technology users may have difficulty understanding the page's heading hierarchy and structure.
recommended_fix: Organize headings in a logical hierarchical order so that the page structure is easier to understand with assistive technologies.
